When deploying sites, enable or disable S3 Lifecycle policies which allow for renders to auto-delete after a certain time. Default is `null`, which does not change any lifecycle policies of the S3 bucket. See: [Lambda autodelete](/docs/lambda/autodelete).

## CLI flag

```text
--enable-folder-expiry
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion lambda sites create`](/docs/lambda/cli/sites/create)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`getOrCreateBucket()`](/docs/lambda/getorcreatebucket#enablefolderexpiry)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setEnableFolderExpiry(true);
```
